channel_compatibility.compatibility_verdict: Partial morphological mismatch due to electrode geometry, though cardiac depolarization axis is broadly preserved.

population_differences.mitbih: 47 subjects, ambulatory Holter with severe ventricular & supraventricular arrhythmias
population_differences.incart: 32 patients undergoing coronary artery disease & myocardial ischemia evaluation
population_differences.clinical_caveat: Different clinical presentation and ischemic ST-T changes are present in INCART.

scientific_interpretation.domain_shift_impact: Macro F1 and recall on external INCART recordings demonstrate measurable performance drop compared to MIT-BIH strict test, confirming that classifier does not generalize identically across hospital acquisition protocols, sensor montages (Lead II vs MLII), and clinical cohorts.
scientific_interpretation.abstention_behavior: The development-calibrated threshold abstains on 86.2% of external beats, showing that uncertainty rises sharply under out-of-distribution distribution shift.
scientific_interpretation.clinical_disclaimer: This external evaluation is exploratory research demonstrating domain transfer degradation; RhythmScope is not clinically validated for diagnostic use.
